items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Styled button with variants and sizes, built on the @foldkit/ui Button helper.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Styled text input with label and description, built on the @foldkit/ui Input helper.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Styled multi-line textarea with label and description, built on the @foldkit/ui Textarea helper.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Styled custom dropdown select (single/multi) backed by the @foldkit/ui Listbox submodel — a real submodel you embed via h.submodel. For a plain native <select> helper, use native-select.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: Styled native <select> with label, chevron and description, built on the @foldkit/ui Select helper. Stateless; for a searchable dropdown submodel use select.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Composable card primitives — Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter. A pure layout primitive.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Styled checkbox with label, indeterminate state and description, built on the @foldkit/ui Checkbox helper.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Styled switch toggle with label and description, built on the @foldkit/ui Switch helper.

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: Styled fieldset with legend and description, built on the @foldkit/ui Fieldset helper.

items.name: nav
items.title: Nav
items.description: Styled navigation landmark with current-page marking, built on the @foldkit/ui Nav helper.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Composable modal dialog — Dialog.header, Dialog.title, Dialog.description, Dialog.footer, Dialog.closeButton. Built on the @foldkit/ui Dialog submodel.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Composable floating panel — Popover.header, Popover.title, Popover.description. Built on the @foldkit/ui Popover submodel.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Styled tooltip with trigger and hover/focus reveal, built on the @foldkit/ui Tooltip submodel.

items.title: Combobox
items.description: Styled autocomplete input with filtering, built on the @foldkit/ui Combobox submodel.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Composable tabbed interface — Tabs.list, Tabs.trigger, Tabs.content. Built on the @foldkit/ui Tabs submodel.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Styled radio options with roving tabindex, built on the @foldkit/ui RadioGroup submodel.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Styled numeric range slider, built on the @foldkit/ui Slider submodel.

items.description: Styled date picker combining trigger, popover and calendar, built on the @foldkit/ui DatePicker submodel.

items.title: Animation
items.description: Styled enter/leave animation coordinator, built on the @foldkit/ui Animation submodel.

items.description: Styled sortable lists and cross-container movement, built on the @foldkit/ui DragAndDrop submodel.

items.name: file-drop
items.title: File Drop
items.description: Styled file input with drag-and-drop support, built on the @foldkit/ui FileDrop submodel.

items.title: Virtual List

items.name: badge

items.title: Drawer
items.description: Bottom-docked modal with grab handle, built on the @foldkit/ui Dialog submodel.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Card-styled floating panel with hover-intent open/close delays (200ms open, 300ms grace), built from @foldkit/ui HoverIntent and Popover.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Vertical stack of collapsible sections with single or multi-open semantics, built on the @foldkit/ui Disclosure helper.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Stateful single-section collapsible panel, built on the @foldkit/ui Disclosure helper.

items.name: context-menu

items.description: Menu styled for right-click use, built on the @foldkit/ui Menu submodel. ⚠ Opens on activation at a fixed anchor, not at the pointer — foldkit has no pointer-position anchor yet.

items.title: Menubar

items.title: Toggle

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Stateful group of toggles with shared single or multiple selection.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: Row of single-character slots backed by one combined value.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Presentational breadcrumb landmark with list, link, page and separator builders.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
